meta.name: apollo-local-dev-loop
meta.description:
Configure Apollo.io local development workflow.
Use when setting up development environment, testing API calls locally,
or establishing team development practices.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo local dev", "apollo development setup",
"apollo dev environment", "apollo testing locally".

copy.tagline: 配置好 Apollo 本地开发环境,方便接口测试与团队协作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在用 Apollo.io 开发,想快速搭好本地调试环境
copy.tagline_en: Set up a local Apollo.io dev environment for API testing and team workflows.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're developing with Apollo.io and need a quick local setup for testing and team practices.

howto.what: 配置Apollo.io本地开发环境，生成.env示例、带日志拦截的开发客户端、模拟API服务器、npm脚本和配额监控工具，方便测试与调试。
howto.when: 当你说“apollo local dev”、“apollo development setup”等，或要求设置开发环境、本地测试API、建立团队实践时触发。

say.text: 帮我配置Apollo本地开发环境。
用模拟服务器测试Apollo API调用。
say.note: 避免真实调用导致限流。

say.text: 给团队设置Apollo开发工作流。
say.note: 按技能输出创建项目结构。

howto.what_en: Configures Apollo.io local development environment, generating .env examples, dev client with logging interceptors, mock API server, npm scripts, and quota monitoring for easier testing and debugging.
howto.when_en: Triggers when phrases like "apollo local dev" or "apollo development setup" are mentioned, or when setting up dev environment, testing APIs locally, or establishing team practices.

say_en.text: Set up Apollo local dev environment.
Test Apollo API calls with mock server.
Set up Apollo dev workflow for the team.
